# FixMyType

> A free, open-source, local Windows typing aid for unreliable keyboards.

## Canonical entry points

- [Public overview](README.md)
- [Documentation hub](docs/README.md)
- [10-phase roadmap](planning/ROADMAP.md)
- [Contributor and AI workflow](CLAUDE.md)
- [Contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md)

## Project commitments

- Windows-first; Dutch and English interface.
- Local-first; no cloud text processing, accounts, ads, subscriptions, or paid local-core tier.
- Keyboard chatter filtering is deterministic and separate from optional local AI repair.
- Text repair is explicit, reviewable, and undoable.
- Never claim roadmap work is already implemented.

## Navigation rule

Use `README.md` as the canonical project overview, `docs/README.md` for explanatory documentation, and `planning/ROADMAP.md` for delivery status. Read `CLAUDE.md` before proposing or making repository changes.
